text:
emily: Quick design check: where do we surface invoice downloads in the spend table? Options in Figma: (1) visible download button on each month row, (2) compact rows with chevron -> slide-out details, (3) compact + small inline icon for download. Thoughts?

noah: I vote visible per-row button. Customers keep writing into support asking "where is my invoice". Making it explicit reduces friction.

tia: Visible is clearer but makes the list tall. Can we auto-collapse older months and keep recent ones expanded?

ben: If we collapse months, make the month toggle a real button with aria-expanded and aria-controls for screen readers. Include a "Show all months" control.

emily: Good call. If we choose slide-out, it must be keyboard-trap-free and announce the month in SR text. Example: "Invoice details opened for March 2026".

noah: Hybrid idea: small visible download icon + chevron opens details. Icon is secondary but discoverable. Details pane holds token breakdown, PDF + CSV exports, and line items.

tia: Microcopy: change header label from "Tokens" to "Compute tokens (est.)" and add helper text: "Estimate based on usage; final bill may differ." Don't show $ inline in compact rows.

ben: Accessibility: tooltips for token legends must open on focus/enter, not hover-only. Popovers should be tabbable and closable with ESC. For slide-out use role="dialog" and restore focus on close.

a11y-bot: Contrast scan: current sparkline color fails in dark mode. Recommend alternate: #94B7FF for dark, axis ticks at 13px and color #BFCBE0.

emily: Dev note: API should return invoiceDownloadUrl in row payload to allow direct download. Example payload snippet: {"invoiceDownloadUrl":"/api/invoices/2026-03-org.pdf","tokens": 45210}.

noah: CTA wording: "Download invoice (PDF)" for primary, secondary inside details: "Export CSV". For org scope, show a consolidated "Download all invoices" in the header.

tia: Move scope selector next to date picker and persist as URL param (?scope=org). Users expect it near filters.

ben: Keyboard flow doc: header scope -> date -> search -> table -> row download -> row details -> close details -> continue. I'll prototype with NVDA.

a11y-bot: Created ticket #5230: "Spend UX: invoice affordances + accessibility" and attached contrast report + checklist (ARIA labels, focus order, tooltips, API field).

emily: Action list:
- prefer hybrid: small visible download icon + slide-out for details (keeps density and discoverability)
- collapse older months by default when explicit rows would bloat the table
- move scope selector to header and persist in URL
- update microcopy to 'Compute tokens (est.)' and show $ only in details/exports
- make popovers keyboard-accessible and ensure ESC restores focus
- add invoiceDownloadUrl to table API
- apply a11y-bot contrast fixes and set axis ticks to 13px

noah: I'll monitor support after rollout and share metrics.

tia: I'll update Figma frames and annotate ARIA hints.

ben: I'll ship a keyboard flow spec and small prototype.

emily: Thanks team, demo on Thursday to finalize. :raised_hands:
